stories.title: 'In his words, he's ready to go﻿': Can Shohei Ohtani break his slump before it's too late?
stories.summary: An ailing Ohtani will remain in the Dodgers' lineup, but L.A. needs him to get his groove back. Now.

stories.title: Sources: FIFA set to change rules that led to Balogun World Cup red card reversal
stories.summary: FIFA is set to amend its rules to prevent a repeat of the controversial reversal of the World Cup suspension issued to Folarin Balogun, sources have told ESPN.

stories.title: WR Harrison will make debut for Texans on Sunday in London, Ryans says
stories.summary: Texans wideout Marvin Harrison Jr. will play against the Jacksonville Jaguars in London on Sunday, Houston coach DeMeco Ryans said Wednesday.

stories.title: LIV Golf should know its future by end of month, attorney says
stories.summary: Robert Fitzgerald, an attorney representing LIV Golf in a bankruptcy hearing, said they'd know by Oct. 31 if they'd "wind down or whether 2.0 is going forward."

stories.title: Real Madrid's late rally stuns Roma in 7-goal thriller
stories.summary: Real Madrid scored three goals in seven minutes, all from corner kicks, to mount a dramatic comeback and claim a 4-3 win at AS Roma in the Champions League on Wednesday.
